---
name: changelog-entry
description: Write a short CHANGELOG entry for the change just made. Use when a behaviour change lands or a version is bumped.
---

# Changelog entry

1. Read the diff and name the user-visible change in one line.
2. Add it under the top "Unreleased" heading in `CHANGELOG.md`, creating the file if it is missing.
3. Start the line with `Added`, `Changed` or `Fixed`.
4. Leave version numbers alone; bumping is a separate step.
